title: CleaveOre
description: A lightweight, tactical mining utility mod that completely changes how you harvest resources. Instead of destroying every block in sight, this mod allows you to cleanly extract precious materials while leaving the environment intact.
body:
![CleaveOre Main Full logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7c552367fc0c3974fc83459290e0b297f238ff34.png)

Overview
A lightweight, tactical mining utility mod that completely changes how you harvest resources. Instead of destroying every block in sight, this mod allows you to cleanly extract precious materials while leaving the environment intact.

**Features**

⛏️ Normal Mine (Left-Click)
Retains standard vanilla block-breaking behavior.
~~~~
Ideal for traditional tunneling, instant peeking, and quickly checking for hidden hazards or blocks directly behind the ore face.
~~~~
**💎 Ore Plucking (Right-Click / Use)**
Cleaves the resource drops straight out of the ore block instantly.
~~~~
Leaves behind a hollow stone shell, allowing you to strip the value from a vein without causing structural collapses or messy terrain gaps.
~~~~
**🛠️ Tool Requirements & Compatibility**
Pickaxe Required: Ore plucking only functions when holding a tool with standard pickaxe capabilities (PICKAXE_DIG ability).
~~~~
Mod Compatibility: Works seamlessly out of the box with custom modded pickaxes, hammers, and multitools, provided they expose native pickaxe behavior.
